title: RAW Galen III.1: residence before assimilation, not transport alone
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. One substance must stay at its recipient long enough for adhesion and assimilation; source argument distinguishes arrival, retention and becoming part of the recipient.

source.unit: On the Natural Faculties III.1, complete opening chapter, printedpp223-225; ends beforeIII.2.
source.checked: Complete chapter read in institutional electronic translation, 1916 Loeb; page warns it is not proofread.
source.content: Attraction presents nutriment; adhesion and assimilation take time. Continued departure prevents them, motivating an intrinsic retentive faculty. The concluding inference explicitly assumes purposeful Nature.

design.whole_passage_relation: A complete argument follows a nutrient and recipient through presentation, residence and assimilation, then gives the contrasting departure case and conclusion. The two cases must reuse the same substance, recipient and process predicates.
two_reused_input_cases: Nutrient x arrives at recipient r and remains: later assimilation can occur.
The same x repeatedly leaves r: mere arrival is insufficient. No quantified minimum time is supplied.
design.rival: Pure conveyance/collection: reaching a destination is the terminal event, without transformation into it.
design.distinct_consequence: A retained but unassimilated intermediate state is legal, and arrival does not entail completion; a transfer-complete account may conflate these.
design.falsifier: Fail if a shared target completion predicate forces arrival=assimilation, or the departure case can only be expressed by changing the nutrient/recipient silently.
design.smallest_step: Author complete positive case, negative case and inference under one group-owned vocabulary; test that the same completion operation distinguishes arrival from assimilation before coding.
new_costs: At least one substance identity binder, one recipient binder and a stage/completion distinction.
No numerical residence threshold invented; teleological premise retained as the source's premise.
predecessors: IDEA000119/GDT891 four vegetative functions: source diagram unresolved. Here the new input is an explicit argument, not its picture attributes.
design.main_gap: No written Voynich residence/completion expression; physiological substance identification remains guessed.
